analysis: The PR makes two test-only changes. Each adds a `case .logprobs: break` arm to a switch over MLXServerGenerationEvent. The arms are at Qwen36ProductionCanaryTests.swift lines 394-395 (head) and FlintAnswerStopTests.swift line 130 (head). This keeps the switches exhaustive after an upstream enum gained a `.logprobs` case. Both files are under Tests/ and are not shipped in the provider artifact. Neither change touches provider runtime code, the coordinator WebSocket contract (TB-002), encryption (T-008), attestation, authorization (TB-011), the prefix cache (T-041), or the add-on hold socket (TB-012). The Qwen canary tests only run when DARKBLOOM_LIVE_MLX_TESTS=1 and DARKBLOOM_LIVE_MLX_QWEN36=1 are both set. They read a hardcoded local model path and image path, with env overrides. They disable the prefix cache (DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE=0) and use no production secrets. Dropping `.logprobs` events in these test helpers is benign; it does not alter production behavior. Open question for the integration pass: the production code that emits and consumes `.logprobs`, including whether logprob data is encrypted or exposed, lives in other files outside this batch. This batch gives no evidence of a regression.
